benchmarks.description: Replay a deterministic small JSONL event log and verify the resulting state hash.
Run stable ordered graph queries with explicit limits and verify deterministic result order.
Run ontology, traceability, policy, snapshot, Git binding, and validation-record checks as an aggregate validation pass.
Index a bounded changed-file set and produce trust-labeled CodeGraph observations.
Scan an existing repository in observe mode and produce a deterministic adoption report.
benchmarks.command: cargo run -p sg-cli -- adopt scan --mode observe

benchmarks.description: Run the full local proof path used as the CI performance guardrail baseline.
Run read-only API graph query through the server surface with bounded scan limits.
benchmarks.command: cargo run -p sg-cli -- api query --view specs --max-nodes 1000 --max-edges 5000
